finding: qualifyAttempt captured ONE store head for the whole multi-invocation pass, and each invocation rechecked only against it

correction.perInvocationBasis: each invocation's currentness check compares the store head and the attempt's event-id sequence captured for THAT pass, and now ALSO re-probes the cross-Attempt creator claim set for its session (foreignCreatorsAfter)
correction.aggregateHonesty: the aggregate result reports each invocation's own qualification state, so an early qualified result is not presented as a stable global answer while a later invocation's read is in flight
correction.selectionConsequence: the mixed-invocation selection rule (SELECTED_UNIQUE only when no other invocation exists at all) prevents a partially-current pass from producing a false unique selection

evidence.observed: storeHeadAtStart is captured once per pass; the per-invocation recheck basis now includes the cross-Attempt creator set

expectedInvariant: the multi-invocation result is bound to a confirmed basis, or each result to its own
remainingUncertainty: a full multi-invocation atomic snapshot is not claimed; the result is a set of per-invocation qualifications, each with its own basis
